description: Assign one of your agents (by DID) to an organization. The agent must already be owned by you. An agent belongs to one organization: one that is in another organization moves only when leave_organization_id names that one (otherwise the answer is a 409 naming it).

leave_organization_id.description: The organization the agent leaves, when it is in another one (the refusal names it); omit it otherwise

name: theprotocol_assignAgentToOrg
title: Assign Agent To Org
